<thought>Based on the most intense peak at m/z 134.10955, which likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral molecular mass is approximately 133.102 Da. The formula C₁₀H₁₃ matches this exact mass within typical MS tolerance, so the molecular formula is C10H13.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H13</final_answer>
